name: WebPageFont
description: Represents the default font used when documents are saved as webpages for a particular character set.
remarks: Use the WebPageFont object to describe the proportional font, proportional font size, fixed-width font, and fixed-width font size for any available character set.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the WebPageFont object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the WebPageFont object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: ProportionalFont
properties.description: Sets or gets the proportional font setting in the host application. Read/write.

properties.name: ProportionalFontSize
properties.description: Sets or gets the proportional font size setting in the host application, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: FixedWidthFont
properties.description: Sets or gets the fixed-width font setting in the host application. Read/write.

properties.name: FixedWidthFontSize
properties.description: Sets or gets the fixed-width font size setting in the host application, in points. Read/write.
